description: Apply an effect from the Effect menu to layers by display name or match name and set any of its controls by name in the same call, or set the controls of an effect already on the layers (Effect Controls panel). Values: numbers, true/false for checkboxes, [x, y] pixels for points, "#RRGGBB" for colours, a menu choice's text or number, a layer's name or index for layer controls, a mask's name for mask controls, an object for the controls inside a group, and a list of strings to replace a Dropdown Menu Control's items. With time, each value is a keyframe

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

controls.description: Control names (as in the Effect Controls panel, or match names) to values, e.g. { "Blurriness": 20, "Repeat Edge Pixels": true }

effect.description: The effect to apply: its display name (e.g. "Fractal Noise") or match name (e.g. "ADBE Fractal Noise"); find_effects lists them

existing.description: An effect already on the layer: its name in the Effect Controls panel (e.g. "Gaussian Blur 2"), its match name, or its position (1 = top)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

time.description: Seconds: set each control as a keyframe at this time

name: set_effect_controls
title: Set Effect Controls
